description: Live api.fda.gov/drug/drugsfda checks performed in-session through the page-fetch tool on 2026-09-18 (UTC) while auditing every 1996-2000 master row. Each entry is the verbatim outcome of one HTTP GET; query_url is replayable. Tokens use openFDA's stored application-number prefixes (NDA/BLA); the earlier N-prefixed probes were vacuous (wrong token form) and are not recorded here. v10 additions (2026-09-18, same session): every 1985-1995 master row absent from the committed openFDA year payloads was re-checked live by application number, plus brand-level confirmation (products.brand_name) for every absent brand, plus 2 positive controls.
